title: All members of ETH Zurich can get a vaccination: For all employees the vaccination is free of charge, for students there will be a cost contribution of 25 CHF to be paid cash on site. The vaccination is optional.
main_content:
Main article: All members of ETH Zurich can get a vaccination: For all employees the vaccination is free of charge, for students there will be a cost contribution of 25 CHF to be paid cash on site. The vaccination is optional.

The vaccination is for ETH-members only. Registration will be open from mid of September on the

Vaccination appointments: ETH Zurich, Zentrum, GEP Pavilion 20 October 2015, 13.30‒16.30 h 16 November 2015, 08.30‒11.30 h

ETH Zurich, D-BSSE, Basel 29 October 2015, 15.00‒17.00 h

ETH Zürich, Hönggerberg, HIT-Building, E 51 10 November 2015, 13.30‒16.30 h 24 November 2015, 08.30‒11.30 h
